name: Aquapact
summary:
This game was made for the GMTK 2026 game jam, with the theme of count down.

Delve deep into the dungeon with your new familiar, fighting monsters and jumping over pits, with goal of getting out of the dungeon alive.

The game fits the theme because the player energy points counts down during battle, and when the countdown reaches zero then the player is vulnerable and cannot attack enemies. The game also features challenge areas that require the player to reach the end without their energy reaching zero.
